$comment: Screens intentionally absent from the navigation tree (apps/admin-web/src/navigation/nav-tree.generated.json). Adding entries here is a deliberate choice — review semestralmente. Each block is documented with the rationale: dialogs/drawers launched from a parent screen, drill-down detail views accessed by clicking a row, auth flows outside the shell (/accept-invite, /reset-password, forced password change), Cocoa gallery/error pages, scaffold utilities, and the two helper components of the tab containers (HostedHead, TabHostProvider). 2026-09-15 (Tanda 5 · L1b): scripts/check-sidebar-coverage.mjs now counts coverage by URL of the tree — a screen is reachable when its key (or the component App.tsx/a tab container binds to it) serves a URL — so the 38 temporary entries of L1a (35 *Tabs containers + NavItemTabs) and every screen that hangs from the tree (FolioDetailScreen, CategoryDetailScreen, CategoryOptionForm, GuestProfileScreen, TenantDetailScreen, ApiReferenceScreen, LoginScreen, ForgotPasswordScreen, GuestSegmentsScreen, GuestPortalSettingsScreen, CampaignManagerScreen) left the list, together with the retired screens (configuration/forms/*, ManualSetupHubScreen, PropertySetupHomeScreen, PersonaGuideScreen, PersonaLandingScreen, KioskSettingsScreen, QualityCasesScreen), whose files were deleted. 2026-09-15 (Tanda 5 · L1c · fix:admin-web-nav): ReportErrorCard (screens/fiscal) is the error card shared by the AEAT report screens (Modelo 303/111/115/180/390), not a screen; listed until the screens lot moves it under components/. 2026-09-16 (Tanda 6 · Finanzas, integración): SplitFolioDialog e InvoiceDetailScreen retirados (ficheros borrados por el lote 6-A); FiscalModelScreen es el cuerpo compartido que exporta screens/fiscal/FiscalModelReport.tsx y que envuelven los seis Modelo*Screen (303/390/347/111/115/180, lote 8-B): componente, no pantalla con clave propia. 2026-09-16 (Tanda 6b · L6): AddPropertyWizard (screens/structure/AddPropertyDrawer.tsx) y PropertyDrawer son el asistente «Añadir centro» y la ficha del centro que abre Configuración › Estructura societaria: drawers lanzados desde el ítem, sin clave propia.
